subject.title: fix(sessions): large histories no longer load entire transcripts

question: Should schema-v10 upgrades synchronously reconcile every configured agent before the Gateway serves requests, while later dirty projections return retryable history-unavailable responses?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but it intentionally trades potentially longer upgrade startup for immediately consistent history and introduces a temporary retry contract after branch-changing writes; that compatibility and availability policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the startup contract
options.body: Accept startup reconciliation and retryable dirty-history responses after exact-head required checks pass and retain the current single-projection design.

options.title: Reconcile after startup
options.body: Start the Gateway first and rebuild projections in the background, accepting that migrated history remains retryably unavailable until each agent finishes.

options.title: Pause schema v10
options.body: Defer the projection migration until a stricter startup budget or separately operated upgrade workflow is designed and proven.

recommendation.title: Approve the startup contract
recommendation.body: Accept startup reconciliation and retryable dirty-history responses after exact-head required checks pass and retain the current single-projection design.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current implementation, proof, and latest reconciliation revisions and is the current assignee best positioned to confirm the intended contract.
